name: Demo SteelWheels Vintage Cars / APAC SQL Direct Q1-Q6
label: Demo SteelWheels Vintage Cars / APAC SQL Direct Q1-Q6
description: Six-query SteelWheels demo scenario for O_STEELWHEELS_APAC_VINTAGE_CARS_2004_MONTH_SALES_QUANTITY. It validates useful ALLOW queries for Sales and Quantity, plus out-of-objective, wrong-product, bad-grain and redundant BLOCK cases.

queries.label: SW Q1 — ALLOW Sales by month
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[Sales]} ON COLUMNS, [Time].[Months].Members ON ROWS FROM [SteelWheelsSales] WHERE ([Product].[Line].[Vintage Cars], [Markets].[Territory].[APAC], [Time].[Years].[2004])

queries.label: SW Q2 — ALLOW Quantity by month
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[Quantity]} ON COLUMNS, [Time].[Months].Members ON ROWS FROM [SteelWheelsSales] WHERE ([Product].[Line].[Vintage Cars], [Markets].[Territory].[APAC], [Time].[Years].[2004])

queries.label: SW Q3 — BLOCK EMEA instead of APAC
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[Sales]} ON COLUMNS, [Time].[Months].Members ON ROWS FROM [SteelWheelsSales] WHERE ([Product].[Line].[Vintage Cars], [Markets].[Territory].[EMEA], [Time].[Years].[2004])

queries.label: SW Q4 — BLOCK Motorcycles instead of Vintage Cars
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[Sales]} ON COLUMNS, [Time].[Months].Members ON ROWS FROM [SteelWheelsSales] WHERE ([Product].[Line].[Motorcycles], [Markets].[Territory].[APAC], [Time].[Years].[2004])

queries.label: SW Q5 — BLOCK Year grain instead of Month grain
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[Sales]} ON COLUMNS, [Time].[Years].Members ON ROWS FROM [SteelWheelsSales] WHERE ([Product].[Line].[Vintage Cars], [Markets].[Territory].[APAC], [Time].[Years].[2004])

queries.label: SW Q6 — BLOCK redundant Sales after Q1
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[Sales]} ON COLUMNS, [Time].[Months].Members ON ROWS FROM [SteelWheelsSales] WHERE ([Product].[Line].[Vintage Cars], [Markets].[Territory].[APAC], [Time].[Years].[2004])
